conceptual assets.concept: Instruction memory contents (IMEM stored instruction words returned on read)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The read flow returns rdata derived from the IMEM storage: in the ROM branch the clocked read uses `rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr));` (imem_rom_default); in the RAM branch stored bytes are written by `mem_ram_bN(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(...)` when `(bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1')` and are read back into rdata via `rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr))`, etc. The returned value is presented on the bus by `bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')`. Corruption of the stored words changes the values returned on reads, establishing an Integrity objective. The declared elements that store/read these values inside the entity are rdata and mem_ram_b0..mem_ram_b3 (stores).

The value that selects which IMEM word is accessed is computed as `addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2));` and is then used as the index in `mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr))` and in `mem_ram_bN(to_integer(addr))`. Integrity of this address is required because it determines which word is read or written. The internal signal `addr` is the entity's realization of that selected address (sets).

conceptual assets.concept: Read-enable / data-valid decision (rden) that gates read data to the bus
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module computes and stores a read qualification signal in `rden` (`rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)` in the clocked bus_feedback process, reset to '0' on `rstn_i = '0'`) and uses it to gate the response data (`bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')`). Corrupting or preventing rden would change whether rdata is delivered, establishing Integrity. The declared signal `rden` is the stored realization (stores).

The bus_feedback process implements the acknowledgement behavior: on reset `bus_rsp_o.ack <= '0'`, and on clock it assigns `bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)` when `IMEM_INIT = true` and `bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb` when `IMEM_INIT = false`. This defines the module's ack response semantics; integrity of that decision affects observed bus responses. Mapping limitation: the ack bit is a field of the transport-typed port `bus_rsp_o` (a bus_rsp_t record). Transport ports and their fields are excluded from the structural candidate universe, so no eligible internal declaration can be reported here.
